context_for_next_testing_agent: Community features fully tested and working. Key findings: (1) GET /api/community-highlights returns top 5 trending landmarks globally with landmark_name, country_name, sample_photo, visitor_count, total_photos, upvotes fields, (2) GET /api/community-photos/photo-of-the-week works with fallback chain (returns week/year even if no photo), (3) GET /api/landmarks/{id}/community-photos returns ALL photos (no 3-photo limit), has diary_locked field (false for pro users), is_preview=false, (4) GET /api/countries/{id}/community-photos same behavior - returns ALL photos with diary_locked field, (5) POST /api/community-photos/{photo_id}/upvote toggles upvote for any user, returns upvoted boolean and upvotes count, (6) GET /api/community-feed returns items with visit_id, type, source, user_name, landmark_name fields. Test user test@wandermark.app has subscription_tier='pro' so diary_locked=false.
